in_marathi.name: Arpan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arpan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arpan means 'giver' or 'donor' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'arp' which means 'to give'. In Hindu mythology, Arpan is a name given to the deity Krishna, who is known for his selfless giving and generosity towards his devotees.
